cues: A lighthouse guides vessels through dark coastal waters by marking dangerous rocks and harbor entrances.
Insulated curtains reduce heat loss, helping a room stay comfortable during cold winter nights.
Compost enriches garden soil by returning decomposed organic matter and nutrients to planting beds.
An alarm clock wakes sleepers at a chosen hour, making morning routines easier to maintain.
Public libraries preserve access to books and provide quiet spaces for study and community learning.
